production.note: US model years 2020-2022. First: 'The all-new 2020 Mustang Shelby GT500'. Last: Cars.com lists a 2022 Shelby GT500 (cars-com-2022-gt500), and Ford Authority says of the 2023 Mustang that the Shelby GT500 was discontinued, removing the 5.2L Predator engine from the lineup (fordauthority-mustang-2023).

displacementL.note: '5.2L'. No opened page prints the cc figure; Cars.com lists '5.2 L/315' (cars-com-2020-gt500).

aspiration.note: 'supercharged 5.2L Predator V8'; Motor Authority: 'a 2.65-liter Eaton blower'.

drivetrain.note: 'The power is then routed to the rear wheels via a Tremec 7-speed dual-clutch transmission'

powerHp.note: Ford press release (19 June 2019) reproduced by Motor1. Quote: "The all-new 2020 Mustang Shelby GT500 will produce 760 horsepower and 625 lb.-ft. of torque, making it the most powerful street-legal Ford ever". Cars.com gives '760 @ 7300' for 2020 and 2022.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL. Base car, 7-speed DCT (the only transmission). Motor Authority (Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 15 August 2019): "One of the most controversial specs revealed by the manual is the car's curb weight of 4,225 pounds", from a Ford dealer training manual obtained by the Mustang6G forum. Ford Authority (Jonathan Lopez, same day): "the base curb weight is tipped to be 4,225 pounds" (fordauthority-gt500-weight-2019). Ford did not confirm it. Cars.com lists 4,183 lb (cars-com-2020-gt500), 1.0% lower; see discrepancies.

sources.publisher: Ford Motor Company (press release reproduced by Motor1)
sources.title: 2020 Mustang Shelby GT500 power announcement (19 June 2019)
2020 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 specs deep dive (Viknesh Vijayenthiran)
2020 Mustang Shelby GT500 weighs 4,200 pounds (Jonathan Lopez)

discrepancies.reason: Unknown. 4,225 lb is from a Ford dealer training manual as reported by Motor Authority and Ford Authority; 4,183 lb is the Cars.com database figure for 2020 and 2022. They differ by 1.0%.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,225 lb, the figure from a Ford document reported by two named-author outlets; the database figure is within the 2% the provisional rules allow.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 4,225 lb rests on Motor Authority and Ford Authority relaying one leaked Ford dealer training manual (Ford did not confirm it); Cars.com lists 4,183 lb. A Ford specification sheet or a major magazine's spec panel would replace it and settle which figure is right.
